decisions.statement: The index is named for the unique kind it files.
A file is found by the property then the value.
A page unique across every page is filed under no scope.
Only the `page` page type declares an identifier unique across every page.
An id reaches a page without opening any page.
A file has one line for each page with the value.
A page with an identifier another page already has does not land.
An identifier unique within anything narrower is filed nowhere here.

definition: an index from an identifier unique across every page to the page with it
